logicContract parameter is forwarded into _spawn's init code construction.

createWhitelistedOtoken writes the new oToken address into idToAddress.

getWhitelistedOtoken reads the idToAddress mapping.

createWhitelistedOtoken pushes the new oToken into the otokens array.

The new oToken address is passed to the external whitelistOtoken call.

createWhitelistedOtoken checks the expiry against MAX_EXPIRY.

createWhitelistedOtoken reads the AddressBook for whitelist and oToken implementation.

getTargetOtokenAddress calls _computeAddress to derive the deterministic address.
_spawn uses the fixed SALT constant for CREATE2.
_computeAddress uses the fixed SALT constant for the CREATE2 address derivation.
